test_goal: Generate analytic primitive body-offset recipes with property and coordinate-extreme oracles, not just non-empty output checks.
risk_summary: A body offset can succeed and remain topologically valid while using the wrong sign, distance, extent, or volume.

geometry.parameter_notes: Use dimensions with analytically predictable bbox extrema and volume; keep the offset well away from collapse.

expected_behavior: Exactly one valid result body has finite properties and calibrated analytic bbox/volume values within explicit tolerances.
notes: Return flat_recipe only and use source_* fields rather than target/tool aliases.
